IPDT.description: Imperfection Data (IPDT). One entry per story key; the story key ties the imperfection settings (initial column-inclination and user coefficients) to a defined story.

STORYNAME.description: Story Name. Name of the story this imperfection data belongs to. On read it is taken from the matching story (STOR) record for the same key.

HEIGHT.description: Height of the story used for the imperfection calculation.

COLX.description: Number of columns in the X direction used to compute the imperfection reduction.

COLY.description: Number of columns in the Y direction used to compute the imperfection reduction.

USERCOEFF.description: When true, the user-defined inclination coefficients (USERCOEFFX / USERCOEFFY) are used instead of the automatically computed values.

USERCOEFFX.description: User-defined imperfection (inclination) coefficient in the X direction. Applied when USERCOEFF is true.

USERCOEFFY.description: User-defined imperfection (inclination) coefficient in the Y direction. Applied when USERCOEFF is true.
